The in-form Kristoffer Haugen could be Viking’s best route to success here having contributed to six goals in as many appearances for the club (G3, A3) - his last four goals came before half-time. Joy-Lance Mickels was on target at the weekend for Sabah, and in their sole league phase win, but his last three goals arriving on or beyond the 70-minute mark suggests they may have to be patient here.

Neither side appears to have any fresh concerns for this game. [...] Viking have scored in a club-record 11 successive European matches.

Six of Sabah’s last eight away games produced over 2.5 goals.

Sabah lost the corner count in all three league phase games this term.
